title: PATH-OS delivery receipt
description: One signed receipt shape for every service delivery in commerce/offers.json. Signed by the seller under the pathos-delivery-receipt:v1: domain separator over sha256-hex of the JCS form of the receipt without its signature, where JCS is the repository's src/jcs.ts (RFC 8785 with the same string preprocessing every other PATH-OS attestation uses); use that helper or the packaged @pathos-labs/dacs-jcs to reproduce signatures byte for byte. src/lib/delivery-receipt.ts implements these checks and two more the schema cannot express: for verify-bundle, endpoint.resourceId must equal quoteRef and idempotencyKey and its 16-hex part must be the prefix of inputHash (the endpoint derives resourceId from the first 16 hex of sha256(request bytes)); and issuedAt must be a real calendar date-time (2026-02-30T14:00:00Z and 24:00:00 are refused). The tests and the verifier run the code; this document is the shape's public description. The receipt attests delivery only: it does not verify the payment (the buyer checks the named transaction on chain for recipient, network and amount) and nothing is put on chain.

quoteRef.description: the 402 resourceId for verify-bundle; the quote id for manual orders

idempotencyKey.description: repeating a delivery with this key returns the same deliverable; not being billed twice is the seller's stated policy, enforced in code only for verify-bundle

inputHash.description: sha256 of the exact input bytes

resultHash.description: sha256 of the delivered result bytes

endpoint.description: verify-bundle only: mirrors the endpoint's own receipt
